observations.storage_shape: one JSON document holding every record; every issue and every consume rewrites the whole document atomically under flock with fsync

code_facts: RuntimeJobEngine.authorizationScopeFingerprint includes `inputs=<canonical JSON>` and `planDigest`, so two taps at different coordinates hash to different capability IDs.
automaticRuntimeCapability mints a record per distinct scope fingerprint; consumeCapabilityBeforeMutation rewrites the document again.
consequence: Under a per-input-Job shape, every pointer coordinate a user touches adds a permanent ~4 KB record and forces two full-document rewrites. The rewrite cost grows with the store, so an interactive session degrades quadratically and the store never shrinks. This is a storage argument for session-scoped capability that stands independently of the latency argument in TASK-IDC-001.
product_constraint: The published input operations must not be exposed through an App input surface before the session scope exists; today they are catalog-level primitives for typed callers, not an interactive control plane.
